name: MiniMax H3 RefMods (jedsdead fork)
author: fork by jedsdead; original Wan2GP port by g3n3rativ3; original concept by Luisa (luisacaotica/ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3Mod)
description: No-training 'reference mods' for MiniMax H3 Ref2VA and FL2VA: compress an image/video/audio reference into a small .safetensors file once, then reuse it at any strength without re-encoding it every generation. Fork with sliding-window, two-phase and FL2VA support.
